captions: The children heard something below the ice. I heard it too. We came down the pass because I would rather be embarrassed in a warm room than brave on a breaking path.
Mira wrote that the Grid drove us out. I did not say that. I said what I heard and what we chose.
She came to apologize. I would like her record to be as careful as her apology.

choices.text: I’ll carry your words as you said them

greeting.repeatText: We arrived before the schedule said we would. Why the ice sounded that way is still a question.

captions: I heard the relay answer after the test. I still ask Seli whether I have written what she meant.
